items.title: Lew Tabackin interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 17, 1999
items.q: but I got a call to join Cab Calloway’s reunion band.

ctx.x: That’s important. If you play in the rests you give yourself away right away. But it was a trial and error situation. And then an interesting thing happened. To this day I don’t know why this happened, but I got a call to join Cab Calloway’s reunion band. I mean trying to put together as many of the old guys as he could. And I am 25, maybe 26 by then. And I show up in New Jersey and I go into the dressing room and there was what appeared to be really old guys. I don’t think they were that old now in a different…
Oh yeah, he was a real strong fellow.
